brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy
requirements.evidence: 3-cell linear caddy (piece:0,-1,0; piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0) with divided bins: 3+3 compartments on ends (6) and 2 compartments centre = 8 sorted compartments total. Rod accessories on outer faces can hold thread/spools. Tweezers prop placed indicates small-tool storage.

Central and end bins provide compartmentalization for notions; prop placement limited by bin wall collisions but tweezers staged in bin centre. Physical bins themselves provide the organizing function; no sewing-specific props exist in catalog.

finish.summary: Compact 3-hex organizer with 8 compartments (2× 3-compartment bins + 1× 2-compartment bin) and side rod mounts for hanging. Provides sorted storage for sewing notions like thread, scissors, needles, buttons. Staged with tweezers to show small-tool use.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
